# Marked

Version: 17.0.5. Source: Codex bundled workspace runtime node_modules/marked/lib/marked.esm.js, copied without modification as marked.mjs. MIT license retained in LICENSE.md.

Upstream: https://github.com/markedjs/marked

Used only while generating HTML with Node.js. No parser or JavaScript is embedded in the resulting preview. No network access or npm install is needed for conversion.
